claims: Flynn Clayman is the head men's basketball coach at High Point University.
Flynn Clayman was hired on April 11, 2025.
Flynn Clayman was hired as the 15th head coach in High Point University men's basketball program history.
Flynn Clayman previously served as an assistant coach at High Point University.
Flynn Clayman previously served as an assistant coach at Southern Utah.
Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to their first NCAA tournament appearance.
Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to back-to-back Big South Regular Season titles.
Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to a 2026 NCAA tournament first-round victory over Wisconsin.
Flynn Clayman was hired following the departure of Alan Huss.
Alan Huss left to become the associate head coach at Creighton.
